description: Get the status, cost and output of one video job, including Higgsfield, HeyGen, camera, relight, ltx-2.5-alpha-gen, ruby HDR and enhance-frame-rate jobs. When enable_caption=true on heygen-lipsync-v3 or heygen-translate, completed jobs expose a signed .srt subtitle download URL in output.caption_url; when enable_dynamic_duration=true or runway-gwm1-avatar uses speech_mode="text", is_hold=true indicates the hold is still settling to actual usage.
name: get_video
